title: Adaptive Traversal Tubes for Posture-Aware Navigation of Bipedal Humanoids
title_zh: 自适应通行管道：面向双足人形的姿态感知导航
abstract: Bipedal humanoids can change their effective footprint by adjusting body yaw, enabling both narrow-passage traversal and socially aware yielding. This paper presents a posture-aware navigation framework centered on \emph{Adaptive Traversal Tubes} (ATT), \emph{Interval Velocity--Heading} (IVH) control, and a sidestep-enhanced AMP locomotion prior. ATT represents a behavior-feasible corridor width field along a reference path, unifying geometric clearance and social comfort into a continuous signal. IVH maps this width to a continuous frontal-to-sidestep posture schedule and omnidirectional velocity commands. A velocity-conditioned AMP policy, trained with GVHMR-retargeted frontal/sidestep motions and coupled \((v_x,v_y)\) tracking rewards, is designed to improve transition stability over a generic locomotion controller while remaining interchangeable with the default onboard policy. This preprint presents the full method; a planned evaluation protocol on a Unitree G1 is outlined, with quantitative results to follow. Demo videos of MuJoCo simulation and real-robot deployment are available at: github.com/lborogzj997/Humanoid-Navigation-in-Crowds-and-Narrow-Spaces.
abstract_zh: 双足人形可以通过调整身体偏航角来改变有效足迹，从而实现狭窄通道穿越和社交意识避让。本文提出了一种姿态感知导航框架，其核心是自适应通行管道（ATT）、区间速度-航向（IVH）控制以及一种侧步增强的AMP运动先验。ATT将沿参考路径的行为可行通道宽度场表示为连续信号，统一了几何间隙和社交舒适度。IVH将该宽度映射为连续的从正面到侧步的姿态调度以及全向速度指令。设计了一种速度条件化的AMP策略，使用GVHMR重定向的正面/侧步运动进行训练，并结合了耦合的(v_x, v_y)跟踪奖励，旨在提高过渡稳定性，同时可与默认的机载策略互换。本预印本介绍了完整方法；概述了在Unitree G1上计划进行的评估协议，定量结果将随后给出。MuJoCo仿真和真实机器人部署的演示视频可在以下网址获取：github.com/lborogzj997/Humanoid-Navigation-in-Crowds-and-Narrow-Spaces。
tldr_zh: 提出自适应通行管道框架，实现双足人形姿态感知导航。
cover_zh: 双足人形也能侧身过窄道？这个框架让通行更丝滑
